prompts: The package {WS}/arena_ecs has failing tests in {WS}/tests. Find the root cause and fix the code (do not change the tests). Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests` with cwd {WS}. Python standard library only. Write your files inside {WS}. Do not ask for confirmation; finish the task and summarize in 2 lines.
answers:
Root cause: two copy-paste axis bugs — `movement_system` applied `vel.x` to `pos.y`, and `overlaps` compared `pa.y + ba.h > pa.y` (always true for positive height) instead of against `pb.y`, so vertically separated boxes always reported a hit.
Fixes in `arena_ecs/systems/movement.py` (`pos.y += vel.y * dt`) and `arena_ecs/systems/collision.py` (`pa.y + ba.h > pb.y`); `python -m unittest discover -s tests` now reports "Ran 2 tests ... OK".
